plan.title: ROADMAP.md is Completed-only again — no forward-looking product roadmap (#632 recurrence)

narratives.Description: ROADMAP.md is Completed-only again — no forward-looking product roadmap (#632 recurrence)
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Rendered `ROADMAP.md` on `deftai/directive` is effectively a completed-issue cemetery: a single `## Completed` section with hundreds of shipped items and **no forward-looking phases / upcoming work**. Operators and agents opening the file for "what is the product roadmap?" get history, not a plan.

This is a recurrence of the post-v0.20 collapse fixed once in #632; the symptom is back under the current lifecycle + render contract.

## Current evidence (2026-07-19)

- Root `ROADMAP.md` is auto-generated (`task roadmap:render`); banner still claims `Source of truth: vbrief/pending/`.
- The rendered file has only `## Completed` (no Phase / Pending / Active sections).
- Lifecycle snapshot at filing time:
  - `xbrief/pending/`: **0** scopes
  - `xbrief/active/`: **0** scopes
  - `xbrief/proposed/`: **~40** scopes (not projected into ROADMAP as forward plan)
- So the "roadmap" view collapses to completed history whenever WIP/pending is empty, even though substantial proposed work exists.

## Why this matters

- `ROADMAP.md` is documented as a rendered **backlog / roadmap** view (`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/FILES.md`, `docs/CONCEPTS.md`), not a changelog adjunct.
- Agents and humans preload it for orientation; a Completed-only file trains the wrong mental model and hides the real forward queue (`proposed/`, triage cache, plan-sequence).
- Nearby work (#762 phase taxonomy, #456 lifecycle `report`, #963 ROADMAP preload) does not own restoring a durable forward-looking product roadmap for this repo.

## Prior art

- **#632** (closed): same symptom after v0.20 self-migration — restore Phase 3–6 forward structure when `pending/` emptied.
- **#615** (closed): docs note that render includes `completed/` even when `pending/` is empty (explains the 28KB+ Completed-only output).

## Desired outcome

File / ship enough product + process so that `ROADMAP.md` (or its successor view) again answers "what is coming next?" for directive maintainers and consumers, not only "what already shipped."

Possible directions (non-prescriptive; pick in triage/design):

1. **Projection fix**: include a forward section from `proposed/` and/or ranked triage / plan-sequence, with clear status labels, not only `pending/` + `completed/`.
2. **Process fix**: keep a durable promoted forward plan in `pending/` (or plan-sequence) so release-time `roadmap:render` always has phases.
3. **Product split**: demote Completed-heavy history out of `ROADMAP.md` (archive / report via #456) and keep ROADMAP for forward work only.
4. **Dogfood content**: author an explicit near-term product roadmap (themes / phases) for directive itself, then project it.

## Acceptance sketch

- Opening `ROADMAP.md` on this repo shows at least one non-empty forward-looking section (phases, themes, or upcoming scopes) when open work exists in lifecycle/triage.
- Completed history does not drown out the forward plan (cap, separate archive, or default omit).
- Banner / docs accurately describe which folders and selection rules feed the forward section.
- Regression test or check: empty `pending/` + non-empty `proposed/` (or equivalent) must not yield Completed-only output without an explicit, documented empty-forward state.

## Related

- #632 (closed recurrence)
- #615 (render sources)
- #762 (phase taxonomy)
- #456 (`task report` lifecycle slicing)
- #963 (README/ROADMAP preload into skills)


---

## Issue comment thread

_The issue body is the original write-up; maintainer comments below may supersede it. Read the full thread before building a dispatch envelope (#2143)._

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-01T01:05:08Z)

## LockedDecisions (as of 2026-08-01)

Canonical decision record for #2653. Body remains the problem statement; this comment is the locked design stance until amended in place or superseded by a later pass-N note.

### D0 — Validity

- **D0.1** Symptom is real and current: `ROADMAP.md` is Completed-only when `pending/` is empty/near-empty while substantial forward work lives in `proposed/` / triage.
- **D0.2** Classed as a **framework projection + contract bug** (consumer-affecting), not docs-only.
- **D0.3** This is a **#632 recurrence**: #632 re-seeded pending content; it did not change projection rules, so empty-pending collapse returns under triage-first / low-WIP process.

### D1 — Source of truth (what ROADMAP is for)

- **D1.1** `ROADMAP.md` MUST answer **"what is coming next?"** for maintainers, consumers, and agents — not only **"what already shipped."**
- **D1.2** Completed history is secondary and MUST NOT drown the forward plan (cap, archive, separate report, or default omit).
- **D1.3** Banner and docs MUST name real selection rules and layout (`xbrief/…`, not stale `vbrief/pending/` alone).

### D2 — Projection rules (locked for implementation)

- **D2.1** Forward section(s) MUST be projected when open work exists. Minimum v1 input: **`xbrief/proposed/`** (and/or plan-sequence current entry + ranked triage when those surfaces are present). `pending/` remains the primary "accepted/in-flight plan" bucket when non-empty.
- **D2.2** Empty `pending/` + non-empty `proposed/` (or equivalent forward source) MUST NOT yield Completed-only output without an explicit, documented empty-forward marker. Regression test required.
- **D2.3** Completed projection: **cap or default-omit** in `ROADMAP.md` (exact policy in implement PR: e.g. last N / age window / separate `ROADMAP-HISTORY.md` / `task report` #456). Unbounded completed dump is forbidden as the sole visible section when forward work exists.
- **D2.4** Renderer SoT stays lifecycle (and optional plan-sequence/triage projection) — not hand-edited ROADMAP. `task roadmap:render` remains the generator.

### D3 — Non-goals

- **D3.1** ⊗ `task report` (#456) alone as the fix for "what next" — useful for history slicing, not a substitute for a forward ROADMAP section.
- **D3.2** ⊗ Requiring durable full-backlog parking in `pending/` as the only fix (fights WIP discipline; will regress again). Process seed of a thin near-term plan remains optional dogfood.
- **D3.3** ⊗ Making ROADMAP the cache-as-authoritative work selector over `triage:queue` / plan-sequence (#1149 / #2402). ROADMAP is a **rendered orientation view**; agents still MUST prefer queue/plan for "what next" work selection.
- **D3.4** ⊗ Implementing OpenClaw/SCM cohort work (#3008 / #2275) under this issue.

### D4 — Implementation slices (ordered)

1. **Slice A — Renderer + contract** (implements D2): forward from proposed (and pending when present); completed cap/omit; banner accuracy; regression test for empty-pending + non-empty-proposed.
2. **Slice B — Docs + dogfood**: ARCHITECTURE/FILES/CONCEPTS/commands alignment; optional thin near-term themes/plan-sequence seed for `deftai/directive` only.
3. **Slice C — History home** (optional, may track #456): archive/report path for completed-heavy history so ROADMAP stays forward-first.

### D5 — Acceptance (locked)

- Opening `ROADMAP.md` shows ≥1 non-empty forward-looking section when open work exists in lifecycle/triage/plan-sequence as wired in Slice A.
- Completed does not dominate when forward work exists.
- Banner/docs match selection rules.
- Automated regression: empty `pending/` + non-empty `proposed/` ⇒ not Completed-only without explicit empty-forward documentation.

### D6 — Priority and ownership

- **Priority:** Medium product-truthfulness; **higher** if agents still preload ROADMAP without triage-first (#963 amplifies wrong model).
- **Owner surface:** `packages/core/src/render/roadmap-render.ts` + roadmap task + docs; lifecycle content optional in Slice B.
- **Cohort:** Own story (or render/docs cohort). Orthogonal to #3008 / #2275.

### Amendment rule

Edit this comment in place for later pass-N decisions; do not replace with a new "LockedDecisions" comment. Body stays the problem statement (claim-cites-state-surface discipline: status claims about the umbrella/issue should cite this note or another state artifact, not the body alone).

Refs: analysis 2026-08-01; #632, #615, #456, #762, #963; renderer `renderRoadmapToBuffer` pending-only forward + always-completed.
